title: Chapter 95 — The AI-Powered Salesperson: Foundations
intro: What AI genuinely does for a salesperson and the ground rules.

sections.title: AI Extends You — It Does Not Replace You
sections.content:
AI handles the tedious, the data-heavy, and the repetitive. Product lookups, spec comparisons, quote generation, follow-up scheduling, performance analysis. These are things AI does faster and more accurately than any human.

What AI cannot do: build trust, read body language, feel empathy, adjust energy, or close a sale through genuine human connection. The 10 Steps are a human process. AI supports it — it does not run it.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating AI adoption, ask:

Is the salesperson using AI to handle administrative and research tasks — freeing up selling time?
Do they understand the boundary between AI support and human relationship?
Are they learning to use AI tools — or ignoring them?
